recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: karl the fog rolling back over the bay at dusk
autumn light thinning on san francisco hills
year-end shipping energy in the air

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a cable car through Karl-the-fog by holding to part the mist and reveal safe track segments before they seal shut.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each run uncovers one new ghost shortcut through the hills before fog reclaims it
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog closes faster and track gaps narrow each block
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted watercolor fog over pencil-sketched SF hills

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Ship by sunrise: tap tiles to spawn micro-agents that patch bugs, but mistaps spawn scope-creep tiles that spread.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: tap to assign agents, avoid scope creep
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: satisfying cascade when every tile flips green as the sun crests
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: scope-creep tiles multiply and agent response slows
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon terminal green bleeding into a dawn gradient

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Drag spinning auth tokens into the correct vault slot — passkey, password, biometric — before they expire.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: perfect streak unlocks slower spins in passwordless mode
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: slots multiply and rotation speed ramps
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: frosted glass vault with metallic key shards

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick timeline orbs into 2026 prediction slots — match each signal to its future before the year collapses inward.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: each correct match adds a glowing fragment to a 2026 mosaic
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: orbs grow heavier and target rings shrink
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: holographic year-digits floating in a soft starfield
